text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Periodic consolidation of accumulated context, as proposed in the new arXiv consolidation paper, can act as a minimal-memory baseline that isolates the benefit of merely having memory (without rewrite) and thus directly addresses Reviewer 2’s demand for a rewrite‑vs‑append ablation in the ICLR submission.","confidence":0.68,"support_ids":["2c2c17d7","333a33b9","221fe923"],"tags":["review-response","consolidation","ablation"]},{"statement":"Integrating MemGPT’s virtual context paging mechanisms with the consolidation technique can substantially lower the active GPU footprint of memory‑rewrite experiments, enabling more extensive use of the approved H100 allocation for large‑scale ablation studies.","confidence":0.55,"support_ids":["cbddd6cc","35803c9a","2c2c17d7"],"tags":["resource-optimization","memory-management","gpu"]}]}
